_about: Scope notes for tools/trace_method.py --status, keyed NAMESPACE::Function (or NAMESPACE::* for a whole library). 'scope' is out (not protocol logic: scheduler, dialogs, error recovery, trace output), method (ported with the method that owns it, not as a library) or inline (a Python expression where it is called). Each verdict is from reading the function's code. See docs/PORTING.md.

LABWAREHANDLING::*.note: the scheduler's labware request/return file handshake

COMMON96HEADSUBMETHODS::Eject96HeadTipsA.note: Head96TipEject UsePickUpPosition 2 read as default waste from the help's option order, unverified; the waste-chute shake has no PLR counterpart

MOVE96HEADANDARM::Move96HeadAndArm.note: firmware H0ZA za68500 (top of Z travel) and H0YA ya07500 (front, 117.19 mm with PLR's resolution), then arm X 1337.5

MPE_LIBRARY::HandleError.note: error dialog and manual-recovery loop around MPE2 commands

MPE_LIBRARY::UserSelectControlPoints.note: operator dialog for the MPE2 control points: a parameter in a port

RUNTIMEERRORHANDLING::TransportError.note: runtime error handling: error files for the scheduler

IF_AND_IF_OR::If_And_3_Variables.note: a == b and c == d and e == f

IF_AND_IF_OR::If_Or_3_Variables.note: a == b or c == d or e == f

VECTORCUSTOMDIALOGS::*.note: operator dialogs and status-window text (a compiled dialog component)

DECKVISUALIZE::*.note: Venus's on-screen deck view during the run: PLR's visualizer shows the same from its trackers

NGSSTARLOADING::MultipleChoiceDialog_Def.note: the run-setup multiple-choice dialog (choices defined, shown, read back)

NGSSTARLOADING::MultipleChoiceDialog_Ret.note: the run-setup multiple-choice dialog (choices defined, shown, read back)
